digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation validity and related-material pin health
propositions: Signed material pins become the single validity check across attestation lifecycle consumers by deriving DerivedPlanReviewHealth with pin_status (current, stale-pin-drift, stale-pin-missing, malformed-pin, legacy-unpinned) and enforced flag
Optional enforce_plan_material_pins configuration gates pin drift invalidation while preserving safe rollout, with fail-open for unreadable config and advisory-only behavior when disabled

compute_validity extended with PlanValidityProfile parameter (DEFAULT, CLOSE, DRIFT_REFRESH) to control which checks run; CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH both disable code freshness while retaining signature/registry/own-material/pin checks
drift_refresh_candidate delegates full validity check via compute_validity(profile=DRIFT_REFRESH) before candidate qualification, blocking reopen and drifted pins from progressive refresh
Re-sign recovery reads reviewed_related_material from sidecar, derives pin health without requiring certified attestation, and blocks on malformed/missing/drift when enforcement enabled
Full LLM plan review threads pre-LLM review_snapshot.related_material through sidecar.emit as ordered PlanMaterialPin list; idempotent reuse and drift refresh retain existing no-sidecar behavior
